title: Vibenix: Agentic Software Packaging and Maintenance with Nix
abstract: arXiv:2610.24712v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Implicit dependencies, uncontrolled network access, and other build-environment impurities create intransparent software supply chains. Identifying every dependency affecting a build is a difficult task. Functional package management addresses this through reproducible packaging, ensuring software relies exclusively on declared, hermetically isolated inputs. However, creating build recipes remains complex and time-consuming, posing a significant barrier to adoption for developers and maintainers. We present Vibenix, an open-source AI-powered agent that bridges this gap by automatically generating Nix packaging expressions. Vibenix uses a large language model (LLM) to iteratively refine recipes through a rule-guided build-repair feedback loop. translated_title: Vibenix：基于Nix的智能体化软件打包与维护
translated_abstract: 隐式依赖、不受控制的网络访问以及其他构建环境的不纯因素造成了不透明的软件供应链。识别影响构建的每一个依赖是一项艰巨的任务。函数式包管理通过可复现的打包解决了这一问题，确保软件仅依赖已声明的、封闭隔离的输入。然而，创建构建配方（build recipes）仍然复杂且耗时，对开发者和维护者的采用构成了重大障碍。我们提出了Vibenix，一个开源的AI驱动智能体，通过自动生成Nix打包表达式来弥合这一差距。Vibenix使用大型语言模型（LLM）通过规则引导的构建-修复反馈循环迭代地优化配方。在我们新提出的NixBench数据集的466个打包任务上，Vibenix使用Claude Haiku 4.5在95.3%的情况下生成了可构建的软件包，而最先进的基于LLM的单次生成方法仅为5.6%。
tldr: Vibenix是一个开源AI智能体，利用大型语言模型通过规则引导的构建-修复反馈循环自动生成并迭代优化Nix打包表达式，在NixBench数据集上以Claude Haiku 4.5实现了95.3%的可构建软件包成功率，远超传统单次生成方法。
